lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
cookbook-main: 207 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 197 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 10 B.
All 2 pages load the same 2 files: 836,215 B raw, 220,917 B gzip, 99.8 % of the smallest page (cookbook-guest, 838,258 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/dialogs 287,525 B, @nextcloud/vue 228,418 B, axios 51,559 B, @vue/runtime-core 47,943 B, dompurify 29,426 B.
moment, 301,959 B on the cookbook-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
682 B in 3 pieces of 2 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (59 packages, 943 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
